lines: Every number you need, live, as you pedal.
Power leads. The bike reports none, so Wattzup estimates it from cadence and resistance, and marks it est.
Three seventeen watts, against a target of three twenty-seven: on target.

lines.text: Push harder, and it reads plus one ninety-four watts.
Ease off, and minus one eighty-five.

lines: Cadence sits beside it, with the segment's aim: ninety-five, aim for ninety-eight.
Underneath, the ride totals: average power, speed in kilometres and miles an hour, distance and energy.
With no workout, it's a free ride: no target, no cadence goal, and Set up a ride one tap away.
On a phone or a tablet, the same numbers lead the screen.
What the tests prove: on target means within eight percent of the target.
And the totals stay on screen after the ride ends, until the next one starts.
That is journey three. Wattzup turns an Echelon bike into a live training display.
